text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat over 24 hours while altcoins show modest weakness, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction at current levels. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and rising indicates sentiment remains comfortably in greed territory, though the lack of price movement hints that buying interest may be plateauing. Bitcoin's dominance sitting at 58.3% with $82B in daily volume reflects steady but not exceptional activity—traders appear content to hold rather than aggressively accumulate or exit.
